items.statement: What electronic-state and metal–ligand bonding description is supported for the supplied nickel carbaporphyrin complex, and how securely can it be distinguished from competing descriptions?
items.expected: Deliver a substantiated electronic-state and bonding description with limits; supported alternative descriptions or unresolved physical oxidation are acceptable. Merely repeating the formal Ni(IV) label or old triplet gap earns no complete result credit.
